name: Chest Dip
summary: A bodyweight press on parallel bars; a forward torso lean emphasizes the lower chest while still working the triceps and shoulders.
setup: Grip the parallel bars and lift yourself to straight arms, shoulders pulled down away from the ears.
Lean the torso forward slightly and bend the knees, crossing the ankles behind you.
Keep elbows slightly flared and the chest open.
Make sure shoulders are warmed up; dips load the shoulder joint heavily.
execution: Lower under control while keeping the forward lean, until the upper arms are about parallel to the floor or you feel a comfortable chest stretch.
Keep the shoulders down and do not let them roll forward.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
mistakes: Dropping too deep with shoulders collapsing forward: stop around parallel or where the shoulders feel stable.
Bouncing out of the bottom: lower slowly and pause.
Shrugging toward the ears: keep shoulders depressed.
Swinging the legs: keep the body still and brace the core.
